The '''Skynara system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Skine sector/Legends|Skine sector]] and contained the celestial body [[Skynara]]. Situated in an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], by [[137 ABY]] the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] lay within the territory both controlled by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] and influenced by the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].

==Description==
The Skynara [[Star system/Legends|system]] was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Skine sector/Legends|Skine sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object of the [[Skynara|same name]] and was situated at the endpoint of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]],<ref name="GG9" /> which linked it to the [[Elshandruu system|Elshandruu]] and [[Suarbi system/Legends|Suarbi systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:GARemnantSouth-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|By 137 ABY, the Skynara system lay within the area of influence of the Galactic Alliance Remnant.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding the Skynara system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] at some point between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Skynara system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

The population of the Skynara system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between one and ten million. By [[137 ABY]], the system had been incorporated into the territory controlled by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. It also lay within the area of influence of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], a faction formed from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Core Fleet|forces]] that had refused to surrender to the [[Fel Empire]] at the end of the [[Sith–Imperial War]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skynara system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-19.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
